# Oakline Furniture — Solid-Wood Furniture Catalogue

> Solid-wood furniture made in small batches in Grand Rapids, Michigan. Twelve pieces, built to order.

## Company Details
- **Brand**: Oakline Furniture
- **Location**: 418 Wealthy Street SE, Grand Rapids, MI 49503, United States
- **Phone**: +1 (616) 555-0142
- **Email**: shop@oaklinefurniture.example
- **Operating Hours**: Tuesday–Saturday, 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM EST
- **Price Range**: $340 – $2,480 USD
- **Craftsmanship Ethos**: Every joint is mechanical (mortise & tenon, dovetailed). All wood is harvested within 200 miles of Grand Rapids, MI. Spot-repairable hardwax oil finishes. 10-year free repair warranty on all pieces.

---

## Shipping & Delivery Terms
- **Local Michigan Delivery**: Free delivery and inside assembly within 90 miles of Grand Rapids, MI.
- **Lower 48 Shipping**: Flat-rate $180 wooden crating anywhere else in the continental US.
